item.title: Melissa Auf der Maur donne vie à son projet « BASS WOMB ROOM �...
item.description: Melissa Auf der Maur donne vie à son projet « BASS WOMB ROOM » lors d’un spectacle multimédia, présenté en exclusivité pour une seule soirée au Gesù. Auf der Maur sera accompagnée sur scène par les musiciens Alex Crow et Betsey Wright pour interpréter des morceaux inspirés de son installation multimédia « BASS WOMB ROOM », actuellement exposée au Musée des beaux-arts de l'Ontario. Cette performance comprendra des titres tirés de ses albums solo ainsi que des morceaux de son récent album « 9’s 4-Track Demos and Field Recordings », le tout sur fond de projections des archives vidéo d’Auf der Maur.Melissa Auf der Maur brings her BASS WOMB ROOM to life with a stunning, one-night-only multimedia performance at Le Gesù. Auf der Maur will be joined onstage by musicians Alex Crow and Betsey Wright as they perform music inspired by her multimedia installation BASS WOMB ROOM currently on view at the AGO. Pulling from her catalog of solo albums and tracks from her recent album of 9’s 4-Track Demos and Field Recordings, set to a backdrop of projections from Auf der Maur's video archives.

item.title: LONDON - PARIS - BERLINTALK TALK TALK TORLONDON CALLING:Rough Tr...
item.description: LONDON - PARIS - BERLINTALK TALK TALK TORLONDON CALLING:Rough Trade #1 Book of the YearBonus Tracks: Thurston Moore @thurstonmoore58 , with special guest @courtneylove and a smoking vagina.PARIS PHOTO:Grand Palais and Red Legs9s girlfriends at late night basement piano bars …BERLIN, BABY:Cool Photography Museum and more Rough Trade!Poets, Painters, People and Canadians abound.Connected in our desire to commune on the simple poetry of memory and mourning of a world now gone, but not lost.  The Analogue is Within.Followed the waves to a womb of one’s own. No Bass, just a couple of Books….To be Expressed.To be Received, by Wide Open Hearts and the Communal, Vulnerable and Raw….THANK YO TO ALL THAT HOSTED, WAITED IN LINE, LISTENED, LAGHED AND CARED FOR CONVERSATION!In a world so ugly, that it is currently bombing and starving children, wielding reckless violence against women, destroying the planet and laying out a red carpet for full tech take over, WE HAVE GOT TO STICK TOGETHER IN OR LOVE OF BEING HMAN and OR PLANET.IT IS COOL TO BE HMANI ️ EARTHxMx

item.title: We can’t believe that it has been one week already since we ha...
item.description: We can’t believe that it has been one week already since we had the pleasure of hosting Melissa Auf der Maur at Prachtwerk in Berlin.Thank you for reading from your Rough Trade Book of the Year 6 ‘Even the Good Girls Will Cry’, divulging great stories in conversation with Christof and signing copies of your photo book and memoir afterwards.We hope you also enjoyed your visit to the store and your brand new Rough Trade sweat shirt.Melissa’s memoir is our Rough Trade Book The Year 6 and you can order your copy and her new photo book ‘My 9s Rock Photographs’ at roughtrade.com now. : @michelepiazza and @lonmai
